This '''rebel group''' was formed by workers on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] and lead by the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Mazara]]. The group protested the treatment of workers by large corporations, primarily those in the [[Yellow District]] of Falleen's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Falleen Throne]], as well as the dumping of toxic waste produced by the corporations on the planet. In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] the group attempted to enter the headquarters of the [[Blackwater Systems]] corporation to uncover secrets that they were hiding from the workers. Before they could enter the building, Blackwater released [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to [[Assassination attempt on Mazara|kill the leader of the group]].
